Keurig Dr Pepper is entering 2026 with new drinks across the portfolio. 7UP and C4 remain product names. The lineup contains more than 35 varieties. Zero sugar continues to outpace the CSD category, driving 6x more dollar growth than regular varieties5, as consumers look for balance without sacrificing flavor.
